name: Shopify orders daily (SyncWith sheet to BigQuery)

parameters.jsCode:
const items = $input.all();
const results = [];

const parseAmount = (val) => {
  if (val === null || val === undefined || val === '') return 0;
  return parseFloat(String(val).replace(/[$,]/g, '')) || 0;
};

const parseDate = (val) => {
  if (!val || val === '') return null;
  return val.split('T')[0];
};

for (const item of items) {
  const r = item.json;
  if (!r['Day'] || !r['Order ID']) continue;

  results.push({
    json: {
      ingested_at: new Date().toISOString(),
      sale_id: r['Sale ID'] || null,
      line_item_id: r['Line item ID'] || null,
      line_type: r['Line type'] || null,
      item_name: r['Item name at time of sale'] || null,
      product_title_at_sale: r['Product title at time of sale'] || null,
      product_variant_title_at_sale: r['Product variant title at time of sale'] || null,
      product_variant_sku_at_sale: r['Product variant SKU at time of sale'] || null,
      product_variant_price_at_sale: parseAmount(r['Product variant price at time of sale']),
      ordered_quantity: parseInt(r['Ordered quantity']) || 0,
      gross_sales: parseAmount(r['Gross sales']),
      net_sales: parseAmount(r['Net sales']),
      refunds: parseAmount(r['Refunds']),
      discounts: parseAmount(r['Discounts']),
      taxes: parseAmount(r['Taxes']),
      unit_price: parseAmount(r['Unit price']),
      unit_price_after_discounts: parseAmount(r['Unit price after discounts']),
      order_id: r['Order ID'] || null,
      order_created_at_date: parseDate(r['Order created at date']),
      order_fulfillment_status: r['Order fulfillment status'] || null,
      payment_status: r['Payment status'] || null,
      status: r['Status'] || null,
      order_currency_code: r['Order currency code'] || null,
      order_cancelled_at_date: parseDate(r['Order cancelled at date']),
      source_name: r['Source name'] || null,
      sales_channel_id: r['Sales channel ID'] || null,
      sales_channel_name: r['Sales channel name'] || null,
      is_pos_sale: r['Is POS sale'] === 'TRUE' || r['Is POS sale'] === true,
      customer_id: r['Customer ID'] || null,
      customer_name: r['Customer name'] || null,
      customer_type: r['Customer type'] || null,
      customer_email: r['Customer email'] || null,
      shipping_country: r['Shipping country'] || null,
      shipping_country_code: r['Shipping country code'] || null,
      utm_source: r['utm_source'] || null,
      utm_medium: r['utm_medium'] || null,
      utm_campaign: r['utm_campaign'] || null,
      utm_content: r['utm_content'] || null,
      utm_term: r['utm_term'] || null,
      landing_page_url: r['Landing page URL'] || null,
      store_name: r['Store name'] || null,
      myshopify_domain: r['MyShopify domain'] || null,
      store_timezone: r['Store timezone'] || null,
      order_type: r['orderType'] || null,
      custom1: r['custom1'] || null,
      custom2: r['custom2'] || null,
      cart_id: r['cartId'] || null,
      fbp: r['fbp'] || null,
      fbc: r['fbc'] || null,
      gclid: r['gclid'] || null,
      product_type_custom: r['productType'] || null,
      is_one_time: r['is_one_time'] || null,
      zigpoll_attribution: r['Zigpoll: Post Purchase Survey - Attribution'] || null,
      zigpoll_main_reason: r['Zigpoll: What is the main reason you bought from us?'] || null,
      day: parseDate(r['Day']),
      product_id: r['Product ID'] || null,
      product_title: r['Product title'] || null,
      product_type: r['Product type'] || null,
      product_variant_id: r['Product variant ID'] || null,
      product_variant_sku: r['Product variant SKU'] || null,
      product_variant_title: r['Product variant title'] || null,
      product_variant_price: parseAmount(r['Product variant price']),
      product_variant_compare_at_price: parseAmount(r['Product variant compare at price']),
      vendor: r['Vendor'] || null,
      utm_source_shopify: r['UTM source'] || null,
      utm_source_first_visit: r['UTM source (first visit)'] || null,
      utm_campaign_name: r['UTM campaign name'] || null,
      utm_campaign_name_first_visit: r['UTM campaign name (first visit)'] || null,
      utm_medium_shopify: r['UTM medium'] || null,
      utm_content_shopify: r['UTM content'] || null,
      utm_term_first_visit: r['UTM term (first visit)'] || null,
      utm_medium_first_visit: r['UTM medium (first visit)'] || null,
      utm_content_first_visit: r['UTM content (first visit)'] || null,
      customer_source: r['Customer source'] || null,
      customer_source_type: r['Customer source type'] || null,
      customer_source_first_visit: r['Customer source (first visit)'] || null,
      customer_source_type_first_visit: r['Customer source type (first visit)'] || null,
    }
  });
}
return results;
